attack: an older corpus id left in an otherwise current block (with a past generatedAt)
why: the receipt corpus is the thing measured; a claimed digest that does not match the layer must be refused as stale
wouldBeWrongIf: READY, or refusal by AUDIT_CORPUS_UNMEASURED (the layer IS readable; calling it unmeasured would be a different, false answer)

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_ID_MISMATCH: only if the derived id did not follow the claimed corpus id, which this fixture makes it do
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FIDELITY_MISMATCH: only if the recomputed counts differed, which they do not (the numbers are current)
